The recording features James Taylor on acoustic guitar. In addition to Taylor, and King on piano, instruments include Russ Kunkel on drums, Charles Larkey on bass guitar and Curtis Amy on flute.^([4]) The lyrics express longing for a lover who is far away.^([4]) AllMusic critic Bill Janovitz notes that while the lyrics start by focusing on the physical distance between the lovers, the lyrics use that as a jumping-off point to explore emotional distance between lovers as well.^([5]) Rolling Stone stated King's "warm, earnest singing" on the song brought out the song's sadness.^([6]) Cash Box said of it that "Carole weaves a magnificent ballad spun of soft, melodic phrasing and soothing
